description: This file contains unit tests for the function 'should_upload_full_test_run' from 'tools.stats.upload_test_stats'. It tests various conditions related to branch names and repository identifiers to determine whether a full test run should be uploaded.

classes.name: TestUploadGate
classes.description: A unittest.TestCase subclass that contains test cases for 'should_upload_full_test_run' function.

methods.name: None test_main_branch_on_pytorch_repo(self)
methods.description: Tests that the main branch on the 'pytorch/pytorch' repository triggers a full test run upload.

methods.name: None test_trunk_tag_valid_sha_on_pytorch_repo(self)
methods.description: Tests that a trunk branch with a valid 40-hex-character SHA on 'pytorch/pytorch' triggers a full test run upload.

methods.name: None test_trunk_tag_invalid_sha_on_pytorch_repo(self)
methods.description: Tests that a trunk branch with an invalid SHA (not 40 hex characters) does not trigger a full test run upload.

methods.name: None test_non_main_branch_on_pytorch_repo(self)
methods.description: Tests that non-main branches on 'pytorch/pytorch' do not trigger a full test run upload.

methods.name: None test_main_branch_on_fork_repo(self)
methods.description: Tests that the main branch on a fork repository does not trigger a full test run upload.
